reuse.why: Uses the existing extractTagsFromText from #shared/tags for tag parsing instead of a hand-written regex, and the existing getBudgetData query for copy-previous.

duplication.why: Removes five pasted category-selection queries in favour of getBudgetActionCategories; only the notes join is repeated between that helper and getBudgetData, and copyPreviousMonth keeps its own JS version of the hidden/template skip.

placement.why: The selection helper and isFixedGroup sit in actions.ts next to the actions that use them, consistent with the tree; the rule is split between a SQL WHERE and a JS filter in the same helper, which is slightly awkward.

scope.why: Focused on month-wide actions; folding the five pre-existing queries into one helper is related cleanup that enables the change rather than unrelated churn.

maintainability.why: One helper plus one predicate is easy to own, though copyPreviousMonth still applies the selection rules separately from getBudgetActionCategories, so the two paths can drift.

one_place.where: The #fixed rule is defined once in isFixedGroup (actions.ts) and used by getBudgetActionCategories (zero, last-month spending, 3/6/12-month averages) and copyPreviousMonth; only the group-notes join is written in both queries.
